title: Simple Netherite
description: Upgrade Netherite with a Diamond instead of a Smithing Template. Simple and Classic In 1.21+
body:
![Crafting Recipes](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/9ba219a4dcc5333116579ae3d7e0475ac6316d70.gif)

## Simple Netherite

The Simple Netherite mod/datapack removes the grind of hunting for Smithing Templates in Minecraft 1.21+. It essentially reverts the upgrade process to a more "classic" feel by swapping rare templates for a common mineral.

## Key Changes
Template Replacement: You no longer need the rare Netherite Smithing Template found in Bastions.

The New "Template": A standard Diamond now goes into the Smithing Template slot.

How to Upgrade
To create Netherite gear, combine these three items in a Smithing Table:

Slot 1 (Template Slot): 1 Diamond

Slot 2 (Item Slot): Your Diamond tool or armor piece

Slot 3 (Material Slot): 1 Netherite Ingot

### Note:
If It Says That The Datapack Is For Older Or Newer Version Dont Worry Just Enable It.
